member.name: F:AvatarStatExtender.Data.ReadOnlyAudioEntry._keepAlive
member.summary:
This array keeps the audio clips from being garbage collected on the il2cpp side (ever).
Without this, the audio might be GCed anyway because il2cpp has its own separate collector. Managed objects serve more as "proxies" to these objects, providing outside access to native memory. By storing them in the il2cpp array, a reference is kept on the il2cpp side, preventing garbage collection.
